output.summary: A free-floating perennial aquatic plant native to tropical and subtropical South America, common water hyacinth has bulb-like, buoyant leaf bases and spikes of lavender-to-pink flowers. It grows extremely quickly, forming mats that can double in size within one to two weeks.
output.edibilityNote: Green parts and flowers are eaten in Taiwan, Java and Vietnam, usually cooked; harvested plants can absorb contaminants and be toxic.
